rationale.consistency: Excellent alignment with the v6 client patterns, including clientcfg extraction and struct-mapping methods.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles int64-to-int32 overflows, zero-archive logic, graceful time parsing, and proper body resets on retries flawlessly.
rationale.scope: Delivers exactly the requirements without over-engineering, keeping the legacy and v6 boundaries clean.
rationale.readability: Very clear control flow, descriptive names, and well-commented orchestration and internal config fields.
rationale.robustness: Safe concurrency and retry handling, proper Context propagation, robust S3 upload with explicit Content-Length, and nil-pointer guarding.
rationale.maintainability: Decoupled logic using interfaces (provisioningNotifier, metricsPusher) and lazyInitProvisioning allows for seamless mock injection and testing.
